hooks.prompt: A Gradle build just failed. Analyze the error output, identify the Kotlin compiler errors or Gradle configuration issues, and fix them with minimal changes.

hooks.command: n=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -c '\.kt$' || echo 0); if [ "$n" -gt 5 ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Large Kotlin change — consider /everything-claude-code:kotlin-review and /everything-claude-code:android-clean-architecture"}'; elif [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Kotlin files changed — consider /everything-claude-code:kotlin-review"}'; fi
